task_title: Wire Floor 2 equipment economy flag into real shipped path

plan_review.notes: Adversarial-style rubber-duck review flagged: (1) headless-runner.ts unconditionally calls runSettlementMaintenancePlanner every tick, a real AI consumer of Quartermaster stock missed in the initial investigation (corrected via grep + code read); (2) needed evidence the AI purchasing path does not break Floor 2 balance/AI or interact badly with carryover; (3) wanted an interactive UI observation for boss chests. Resolved: (1) confirmed via source read that the planner is intentional, bounded (8-iteration cap), fail-safe (blacklist-and-continue), latch-gated, and a Floor 1 no-op; (2) added a new default-path headless test asserting the planner runs end-to-end against real economy-enabled stock without error across a full run, confirmed validateGeneratedCarryover does not require unclaimed registry instances to be claimed (no orphan-bloat risk), and confirmed no floor3 scenario exists yet so the carryover-boundary risk raised is currently moot (documented as a caveat in the handoff); (3) judged headless evidence plus already-merged BossChestUI wiring sufficient for this flag-only change since the interactive UI itself is untouched by this PR.

rounds.notes: CRITICAL: enabling floor2EquipmentEconomy made initializeFloor2Settlement generate Quartermaster stock into the generated-equipment registry BEFORE restorePlayerCarryover ran, violating restoreGeneratedEquipmentRegistry's empty-registry precondition and crashing every real Floor1->Floor2 transition with carryover ('registry-not-empty'). Fixed via a new skipQuartermasterStock option (floor2Settlement.ts) plus a post-restore stock bootstrap in floor2Scenario.ts mirroring the existing restockFloor2Quartermaster merge pattern. MEDIUM: headless-runner.ts's floor2EquipmentFlags override is silently clobbered on Floor 2 because initializeFloor2Scenario unconditionally forces all 4 flags true -- confirmed pre-existing for 3 of 4 flags (this PR just makes floor2EquipmentEconomy consistent), so addressed via a corrected JSDoc rather than a code reorder that risked untested side effects.

Independent re-review verified both round-1 fixes end-to-end: confirmed restorePlayerCarryover never touches floorExtendedState.settlement (no interference with the deferred stock bootstrap), confirmed the post-restore merge exactly mirrors restockFloor2Quartermaster's pattern, confirmed the skipQuartermasterStock branch leaves no other settlement field partially initialized, confirmed the NULL-registry carryover edge case (runKey===null) is safe, and confirmed the floor-transition-carryover.test.ts assertion change is not vacuous (pins down both 'carried instances survived' and 'new stock appended after restore'). No new concerns found in a fresh full-diff pass.
